in_marathi.name: Manjunath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of jewels
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manjunath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manju: Jewel, Nath: Lord. Manjunath is a Sanskrit name that means 'Giver of jewels' or 'Lord of gems'. In Hindu mythology, Shiva is often referred to as Manjunath, the deity who bestows wealth, prosperity, and spiritual enlightenment.
